subject: Risk & Compliance
title: Ransomware Payment Dilemmas
description: A 60-second lesson on Ransomware Payment Dilemmas.

hook.text: Your systems are encrypted. The hackers want $5 million. Your backup is corrupted. Do you pay?

buildup.text: Paying ransom funds criminals but may be the fastest way to restore operations and protect customers.

discovery.text: The FBI advises against paying. But Colonial Pipeline paid $4.4 million to restore fuel distribution.

twist.text: Paying ransom to sanctioned groups can violate OFAC regulations, creating legal liability on top of the breach.

climax.text: There's no good answer. Pay and fund crime. Don't pay and risk your business. Both choices hurt.

punchline.text: Pay the criminals or lose the business. Pick one.

quiz.question: What legal risk comes with paying ransomware to sanctioned groups?
options: Automatic criminal charges against the CEO
